head: PlayStation Plus PC app shuts down on 10 December
dek: Sony is retiring the PlayStation Plus app for PC, which let Premium members stream PS5 games on a computer, on 10 December. Sony says fewer than 0.4% of eligible Premium members used it.
details: After that, the only way to play PS5 games away from the console is Remote Play, which needs your console on the same network.
where: PlayStation Plus app on Windows, from 10 December
means: If you stream PlayStation games on your PC, that stops next month.
todo: Use Remote Play from your own PS5 instead, and check whether Premium still makes sense for you.
thumb_words: PS PLUS PC APP IS ENDING
